examples.en: Atoms of hydrogen are fused to make helium.
Ordered arrangements of large groups of atoms and molecules are highly improbable.
examples.zh: 大的原子群和分子群的有序排列是极不可能的。

examples.en: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.
examples.zh: 两个氢原子和一个氧原子结合组成一个水分子。
